title: Roos comparison with canonical derived-unit normalization
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and every scheme W, the canonical strict Roos complex followed by localization is naturally isomorphic to localization followed by the right-derived tower limit. The comparison respects every actual finite projection. On every K-injective tower I, the actual Roos inclusion is a quasi-isomorphism, and its localized map followed by the comparison is the ordinary-limit complex identification followed by the inverse of the canonical right-derived-functor comparison. Thus the comparison is normalized on resolutions as well as projections. Equivalently, there exists the full PrimitiveCounit.RoosRealization record with projection and resolution normalization, constructed by these equations.

source.place: Tag 0941; canonical normalized K-injective construction in stage3-pur-canonical-tower-roos-comparison.

proof.text: Use the functorial K-injective normalizedRoosIso construction of the canonical projection comparison, retaining its defining inclusion/unit equation. The Roos inclusion is a quasi-isomorphism on K-injective towers. Cancel that inclusion to verify the projection equation on K-injectives, using the canonical derived projection and the limit cone equation. Naturality along a K-injective resolution proves the equation on every complex. Finally specialize the retained inclusion equation to a K-injective complex and rewrite the right-derived-functor unit as the inverse canonical comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0941 and the canonical comparison construction; retain the unit equation already proved in normalizedRoosIso.
